# Sashank Yalamanchili

> Senior Solution Architect with 16 years of experience.

Sashank Yalamanchili, called Sash, is a Senior Solution Architect with 16 years of experience in B2B platforms, legacy modernization, composable commerce and enterprise AI. He lives in Berlin, Germany and Adelaide, Australia. His skills span solution and enterprise architecture, identity and access architecture, data modeling, enterprise integration, composable commerce and MACH, event-driven architecture, legacy modernization, enterprise AI and AI SDLC, with Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS and Azure. He built Stackure, passwordless auth for B2B apps, solo from architecture through production: started by hand to enterprise standards, finished with AI. He holds a Master's in Engineering Management from Western Michigan University, a Bachelor's in Electronics and Communications Engineering from JNTU Hyderabad and the Enterprise Architecture Essentials certification from Fragile to Agile. Whatever it is, he's a message away on LinkedIn.
